title: cdk-construct-secret examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-secret/examples/.

Scenarios:
- minimal/ — defaults (no KMS, no SNS)
- with-kms/ — createKmsKey:true (divergent: creates KMS key + secret)
- bring-your-own-kms/ — kmsKeyArn from bridge fixture
- with-sns/ — createSns:true with read/pub/sub principals (divergent: adds SNS topic)
- replicated/ — replicaRegions (divergent: cross-region replication)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/secret-examples.test.ts.
